review_scope: Read-only review and CSV arithmetic; no new tests, SSH, GPU, system experiment, or production changes.

correctness.reference_caveat: R0 is the fresh self-reference (61 records); canvas/reuse contribute 122 exact candidate comparisons, not three independent Golden datasets.
correctness.downstream_caveat: Full semantic equivalence is reported by capture comparison; persisted input/raw/box hashes and candidate/measurement/tracking values independently agree across variants. Physical depth accuracy is not validated.

calibration.scope: Current ZED calibration used for implementation-equivalence replay, not Val physical depth ground truth

screen_hooks.restore_evidence: Per-pair correctness includes explicit after-restore states. Screen hook snapshots are before finally.restore (restored=false/restore_count=0 expected); final cleanup_passed=true and source finally blocks show restoration, but no per-screen after-restore snapshots were persisted.

graph_final.cleanup: status.cleanup_passed=true; graph_final snapshot intentionally precedes detector.close().

reasons: Neither candidate reaches >=1 ms mean input-ready savings.
canvas has negative mean savings; reuse has two nonpositive blocks.
Both regress P95/P99 in some blocks.
Maximum baseline within-block drift is 1.02245435 ms, greater than reuse mean savings 0.37502104 ms.
screen_conclusion.system_claim: No system A/B or publishing/Hz gain was measured; stopping before system A/B follows the predeclared rule.

diagnostic.interpretation: Resize dominates pre_transform; padding alone is about 0.234 ms per stereo batch in this 50-sample diagnostic, too small to explain a >=1 ms cache-only gain. pre_transform already includes resize and padding; never add them again.
diagnostic.timing_limit: float/normalize are asynchronous method submission walls; input_ready includes final CUDA synchronization. CUDA event span includes host submission gaps and transfer, not pure GPU compute. Diagnostic and screen are different samples/scopes; do not sum or substitute them.

limits: One offline screen, four short blocks; does not establish universal impossibility of future resize optimization.
Serial predictor ownership is required for borrowed canvas/host buffers; current candidates return independent FP32 results.
No GPU Resize, VPI interop, asynchronous overlap, or double buffering was implemented or validated by these candidates.
Replay uses synthetic timestamps and frozen ZED calibration; no physical localization accuracy or live camera/system performance validation.
